findings.description: A Parameter pose blend rejects a rest source but permits destination clip=u32::MAX with seconds=0 and a valid positive-weight concrete source. Current native Blend1d permits only clip-to-clip parameter blends, so this accepts an impossible v3 frame. The native encoder cannot emit it.
findings.requested_fix: Reject rest destination for blend_kind=2 and add malformed SDK frame regression.

reviewed_properties: All previous registry opcodes 0 through 30, records, constants, magic, namespace mappings, enum values and ABI metadata preserved; five new operations appended.
Generated Wasmtime and wasm2c namespace dispatch maps the same five typed calls and parameter positions.
Graph frames use canonical entity/key order, contiguous owned parameter slices, exact framing/strides, bounded finite values, and reserved-field checks.
V3 reads actual native second-pose blend distinct from timed-transition metadata; v1/v2 retain explicit refusal for unsupported blends.
Snapshots captured before callback stay unchanged by queued graph controls, and neither host retains guest memory.
Read imports validate full destination and transfer quota before copying. Same-epoch failures poison commit; stale epochs do not poison a current transaction.
Graph controls queue through existing atomic numeric/structural/log transaction and deferred native membership/range validation.
SDK borrowed parsers expose no rows until validating whole frames; ignored Tick operation errors poison guest callback.
Actual guest parity sources use complete native world-save oracle, committed log parity, pause/endpoints/select-state/reload and mixed-prefix rollback cases.
